mapper.select: select review_id, order_id, equipment_id, user_id, nick_name, rating, content, create_time from rental_review where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into rental_review(order_id, equipment_id, user_id, nick_name, rating, content, create_time) values(#{orderId}, #{equipmentId}, #{userId}, #{nickName}, #{rating}, #{content}, sysdate())
